# Free Image to Video Prompts

Free image to video AI with no daily cap: start with no sign-up, keep going on a free account. Every video comes with sound and no watermark. This Espanso package expands short triggers into structured image-to-video and text-to-video prompts with camera motion and synchronized audio cues for [Free Image to Video](https://freeimagetovideo.ai/?utm_source=espanso&utm_medium=package) or any AI video generator.

### Installation

```bash
espanso install freeimagetovideo-prompts
```

### Usage

| Trigger | Expands to |
|---|---|
| `:fvportrait` | Subtle portrait animation keeping facial features and lighting steady |
| `:fvproduct` | Slow 180-degree studio turntable sweep for product photos |
| `:fvpet` | Natural pet head-turn and ear movement from a still snapshot |
| `:fvart` | Ambient cloud, water, and lantern motion for illustrated artwork |
| `:fvdolly` | Cinematic slow dolly-in with shallow depth of field and ambient audio |
| `:fvdance` | Rhythmic upper-body motion prompt for photo dance clips |
| `:fvrain` | Dusk street rain-on-glass atmosphere with matched rain audio |
| `:fvsunrise` | Golden-hour horizon pan with gentle breeze and morning birds |
